w: As part of summer vacation, the Amdavad Kishore Mandal had successfully organised a cricket tournament that involved all the kishores. Members of the winning and runner-up teams had come to Swamishri for blessings. The kishores asked two interesting questions to Swamishri.

Q: Swami, what type of fielding should we do to catch your agna? A: The Amdavad Kishore Mandal organised a cricket tournament to please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Yogiji Maharaj. One can see from the above question that the motive of the tournament was to become spiritually conscious. Like Pujya Bhagatji Maharaj, who instantly observed the agna of Gunatitanand Swami, we too should do the same. One should have faith and trust in the Guru’s word and not doubt his words. One's faith should be like the agna of calling Girnar.

Q: Every time maya runs us out. What type of batting should we do so that we don’t get out? A: Gunatitanand Swami has said in his talks that when one attains true knowledge one will not get entrapped by maya. True knowledge means the knowledge of atma and Parmatma. Because we have deh bhava (body consciousness), maya runs us out. One should have a firm resolve that no matter what difficulty or pain comes, one’s atma bhava (atma conscousness) should remain steadfast and the conviction that God is the all-doer and whatever He does is for one’s good.

In the evening, the Children's Day saw various presentations and performances by the balaks and their tutors. Children performed a drama, 'Chhiye ame to chhotaji', a dance and another drama depicting the different obstacles they could face for the construction of the new mandir in Leicester. Finally, Swamishri blessed the assembly, emphasizing on the need of mandirs in society: "Today some people say where is the need for mandirs? But if someone were to say where is the need for colleges? Where is the need for hospitals? And are military and police required? Where is the need for courts and judges? Does one ever feel why pile stones for all this? How mad one would be if one were to speak in this manner? Similarly, one who says where is the need for mandirs is mad. Through mandirs one's mind becomes pure. Through the association of a Sadhu one finds the right path. It is not merely a place to sit and ring a bell, but through it so many services are offered to society. Children are inspired with character from a young age..."

A special Youth Day assembly was arranged for youths residing in Amdavad, Gandhinagar and Mahesana. In all, 4,500 youths had assembled. The assembly commenced with dhun, prayer and bhajans by youths. The theme of the assembly was, “Tamara Hriday Akashma Pankhi Bani Udiya Karu”. An interview was arranged with Ishwarcharan Swami and Viveksagar Swami who elaborated upon the youth training given by Yogiji Maharaj and their experiences with Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Swamishri arrived at 11.00 am. The stage backdrop had a giant heart with a bird in a flying pose. Swamishri was welcomed by youths, dressed in white, dancing to the theme song. Several youths who had been observing various satsang niyams received Swamishri’s blessings. Thereafter a wonderful dialogue took place in a skit format. Swamishri gave guidance to youth-related issues like fashion, eating out and marriage. The assembly concluded with the singing of “Re Sagapan Harivarnu Sachu” by the youths.

Swamishri arrived in Houston the previous day at 12.05 pm from Chicago. The Sugarland Mayor Pro Tem Dennis Parmar welcomed Swamishri at the Sugarland regional airport and presented a proclamation. The evening welcome assembly was arranged in honour of Swamishri. The assembly was held in a giant marquee in the mandir precincts. A three dimensional replica of Akshardham was the highlight of the stage backdrop. After Swamishri’s arrival BAPS teenagers and youths performed a traditional welcome dance. Then, on behalf of everyone, Tyagvallabh Swami and Viveksagar Swami garlanded Swamishri. The consul general of India in Houston Shri Shankar Gavai addressed the assembly, “I am really honoured to be here and I welcome Pramukh Swamiji. I had just sat with him for half an hour and he conveyed his simple message on humanity and spiritualism. The volunteer work exercised by the volunteers is exemplary for all.” More than 28 heads of different social and religious organizations welcomed Swamishri with bouquets. The BAPS children and teenagers performed a welcome dance. Finally, BAPS children and teenagers performed another welcome dance. Thereafter Swamishri crowned the assembly with his blessings, “We should never forget our wealth, culture and values while doing our jobs or business. You have come from India, bringing with you your dharma, culture and values. Like the way you look after your money, which you will later give to your children, look after our spiritual wealth and give it as a legacy to your children. Our culture is ancient. Bhagwan Ram and Krishna incarnated on earth. One should read the wonderful Vedas, Upanishads, Gita, Ramayan and other shastras. Daily reading of shastras will purify one’s thoughts and life. Just as you take care of your needs and use objects, similarly you must read our spiritual books, do puja and keep a mandir in the house.” More than 4,000 devotees were present. In the following days Kishore Day, Children’s Day and Youth Day were celebrated.
During the satsang assembly held in Yogi Sabhagruh on Sunday 21st Swamishri steered the decorative rath of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Jabreshwar Maharaj with a remote controlled console.

Today, at 4.00 pm a rath yatra was organized on a large scale on the streets of Dadar. Swamishri performed pujan and arti of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj, Jabreshwar Maharaj and Shri Dakshineshwar Maharaj, who were placed in two decorative palanquins. Senior sadhus carried the palanquins on the streets with the accompaniment of tunes played by a music band and bhajans sung by sadhus. Children dressed in costumes of all Indian states enthusiastically danced in traditional fashion. With male and female devotees participating, the rath yatra procession was 1 km long. The route included Matunga, King Circle, Pritam Hotel and back to the mandir in Dadar. The rath yatra concluded at 7.00 pm.

st.t: Sadhus meet PM Narendra Modi to convey Pramukh Swami’s blessings
w: BAPS Sadhus visited the Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi to convey His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s blessings and prayers. Swamishri had conveyed his prayers for the nation, and for the PM to lead with compassion and care for all. His blessings were conveyed to the PM on this courtesy call by Pujya Ishwarcharan Swami, Atmaswarup Swami, Brahmavihari Swami and Gnanmuni Swami.
